# The Python packages the suite image installs, each pinned to one version and the hashes of its files, so that pip
# installs exactly these files and nothing else. Playwright stays at the base image's version so that the browsers the
# image ships match it. Hypothesis generates the attestation fuzzing suite's requests, and Atheris drives that suite's
# long coverage-guided runs. Atheris publishes wheels for x86-64 Linux only, so it is installed only there. To change a
# version, regenerate this file inside the base image with pip-compile from pip-tools, from a file that holds these
# three lines, and drop the "via -r" comments it adds to them:
#   playwright==<version>
#   hypothesis==<version>
#   atheris==<version> ; platform_machine == "x86_64"
#   pip-compile --generate-hashes --no-header --allow-unsafe --output-file=suite-requirements.txt <that file>
